children.text:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते॥
children.commentary_text:
### भाष्यम् (१.१.१)

This is a commentary for the first mantra of the first Brahmana. The concept of *Pūrṇa* (completeness) is central here. The source is complete, and that which emanates from it is also complete.

children.text:
सत्यमेव जयते नानृतं सत्येन पन्था विततो देवयानः।
येनाक्रमन्त्यृषयो ह्याप्तकामा यत्र तत्सत्यस्य परमं निधानम्॥
children.commentary_text:
### भाष्यम् (१.१.२)

This mantra emphasizes the ultimate victory of truth (*Satya*). It describes the divine path (*Devayāna*) paved with truth, which the sages traverse to reach the supreme abode of truth.

children.text:
अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम्।
होतारं रत्नधातमम्॥
children.commentary_text:
### भाष्यम् (१.२.१)

A commentary on the second Brahmana's first mantra. It praises Agni, the divine priest and bestower of treasures.
